Tile visualiser

See our tiles in a room before you choose

Choose a room, pick a tile, then change the size, layout and grout colour. Every preview uses a photo of the real tile, laid to scale across the floor with the room's own light and shadow.

Visualisations are a guide only. Colour, veining and finish vary between screens and production batches, so we recommend seeing your shortlist in the Bonnyrigg showroom before you order.

The live visualiser needs JavaScript to swap tiles. You can still switch between the three rooms here, or browse BT Specials to see each tile laid in a room.

How it works

From a first look to a firm enquiry

  1. Choose a room

    Start with the bathroom, kitchen or alfresco scene that is closest to your own project.

  2. Lay your tile

    Pick a tile, then try different sizes, layouts and grout colours until the floor feels right.

  3. Add it to your enquiry

    Send the look to your enquiry cart and our team will confirm availability and final pricing.
